messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Art. 29

Article 29 Information obligation of notifying authorities Member States shall inform the Commission of their procedures for the assessment and notification of conformity assessment bodies and the monitoring of notified bodies, and of any changes thereto. The Commission shall make that information publicly available.

response.text:
Member States | shall inform | the Commission of their procedures for the assessment and notification of conformity assessment bodies and the monitoring of notified bodies | | Member States shall inform the Commission of their procedures for the assessment and notification of conformity assessment bodies and the monitoring of notified bodies
Member States | shall inform | the Commission of any changes to those procedures | | and of any changes thereto
Commission | shall makePubliclyAvailable | the information received from Member States on those procedures | | The Commission shall make that information publicly available.
